articles.summary: Cleveland — SIFCO Industries, Inc. (NYSE American: SIF) today announced financial results for its first quarter of fiscal 2026, which ended December 31, 2025. First Quarter Results Net sales in the first quarter of fiscal 2026 increased 8% to $24.0 million, compared with $20.9 million for the same period in fiscal 2025.
